newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga board to meet on Santa Fe takeover.
newsitem.headline: Saga board to meet on Santa Fe takeover.

text.p: Norway's Saga Petroleum ASA has been given the green light by Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) to acquire British-based Santa Fe Exploration Ltd, market sources in London said on Monday.
The sources said Saga would pay $1.2 billion for the North Sea exploration and production group.
They said Saga's management would meet its supervisory board at 1900 GMT on Monday to get final approval for the deal.
A spokesman for Saga would confirm only that a meeting would take place but not the reason for the gathering.
Share trading in Saga, Norway's largest independent oil company, was suspended on the Oslo bourse on Monday in anticipation of an announcement on the takeover.
Conoco of the United States, a unit of E.I. Du Pont De Nemours and Co, also participated in the bidding.
